crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”
Thus said Yahweh, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people, and of the…
and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words…
at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and…
“You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
Thus he showed me and behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.
God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them…
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

translations.web: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”
translations.bsb: “Go down at once to the potter’s house, and there I will give you My message.”
translations.kjv: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
translations.asv: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
